name: nextjs-saas-dashboard
title: Lumeo Analytics – SaaS dashboard (Next.js 15)
description: Fictional product-analytics SaaS: marketing pages plus a role-protected dashboard and admin area. Auth is a jose-signed HS256 JWT in an httpOnly cookie, enforced by Next.js middleware.

env.name: AUTH_SECRET
env.description: HS256 secret used to sign/verify the session JWT. Falls back to the demo value when unset; set a long random string in real deployments.

env.name: PORT
env.description: HTTP port of the standalone server.

env.name: HOST
env.description: Bind address (npm start maps it to Next's HOSTNAME).

env.name: COOKIE_SECURE
env.description: Set to "true" behind HTTPS so the session cookie gets the Secure flag. Keep false for plain-HTTP smoke tests.

env.name: DATA_DIR
env.description: Directory holding db.json (auto-created and seeded on first request).

auth.description: Login (Server Action form or POST /api/login) verifies a bcryptjs hash and sets cookie `lumeo_session` = HS256 JWT (8h, httpOnly, SameSite=Lax). middleware.ts verifies it for /dashboard/* (any user) and /admin/* (role admin); unauthenticated -> 307 to /login?next=..., non-admin on /admin -> 403.

persistence: JSON file at data/db.json (DATA_DIR), auto-created and seeded with 3 users + 8 projects on first request; role changes are written back to it.
notes: Requires a writable DATA_DIR (Docker: mount a volume at /app/data). `npm start` runs the Next.js standalone server (.next/standalone/server.js) produced by `npm run build`; the build's postbuild step copies static assets into it. Smoke test: POST /api/login with JSON {email,password} using a cookie jar, then GET /dashboard (200) vs. without cookie (307 to /login). `npm audit` reports advisories only in Next's bundled postcss (transitive; fix requires Next 16).
